## 黑着跑 0.1.4

- 逐台显示器断电：支持 DDC/CI 的显示器在「只关所选」和远程控制模式下也能单独断电，其余盖黑色遮罩；每台可设「自动 / 仅遮罩 / 断电」。不响应断电指令的显示器会被自动识别，之后只用遮罩。
- 选「全部显示器」且未开远程控制时，仍用系统关屏让所有显示器真正断电。
- 新增「放行远程控制」（默认关）：向日葵、ToDesk、Parsec 等远程软件的键鼠操作不再唤醒，本机屏幕保持关闭；远程软件的虚拟显示器不会被遮挡或断电。
- 远程桌面（RDP）会话中不息屏，息屏时有 RDP 连入会自动唤醒。
- Mac：内建屏息屏时背光调到 0，唤醒后恢复。
- 自动更新下载失败时自动重试两次。

## BlankRun 0.1.4

- Per-display power-off: displays with DDC/CI can be powered off one by one, including in "Selected only" and remote-control mode; the rest get a black overlay. Each display can be set to Automatic, Overlay only or Power off. Displays that ignore power-off commands are detected and use the overlay from then on.
- "All displays" without remote control still uses the system display-off, so every display really powers off.
- New "Allow remote control" (off by default): input from Sunlogin, ToDesk, Parsec and similar tools no longer wakes, and local screens stay off. Virtual displays from remote tools are never covered or powered off.
- No blanking inside a Remote Desktop (RDP) session, and an RDP connection while blanked wakes the screens.
- Mac: the built-in display's backlight goes to 0 while blanked and is restored on wake.
- Update downloads retry twice on network errors.
